reasonFollowups.a: Totally get it, happens to the best of us! Quick context on why it matters: Metaview is what lets us write specific, accurate scorecards without relying on memory, and it feeds into using interview data to help improve our offer-acceptance rate — every missed recording is a missed data point there. Simplest fix going forward: admit it every time it asks to join, no exceptions needed on your end 🙏
reasonFollowups.b: Good to know — that happens sometimes, especially around rescheduled interviews (the bot occasionally doesn't request to join, or the invite link gets confused). Two things that help: 1) if it isn't showing up, add notes@bot.metaview.ai as a guest on the meeting and it'll join within a few minutes — try to catch it early, since it'll leave if more than 30 minutes have passed since the scheduled start; 2) if this keeps happening to you, flag it to #hiring with the candidate name and time so we can dig into the root cause.
reasonFollowups.c: Thanks for confirming! If Metaview shows as joined on your end but notes still aren't showing up on our side, that's worth flagging to #hiring with the candidate name and time so we can dig into what's going on — better to catch it than assume it's a one-off.
reasonFollowups.d: Can you share more context? We are happy to help troubleshoot.
